memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Sciatica: acute radicular pain L5-S1, straight leg raise positive 40°. Plan: start pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; order MRI lumbar spine.
Epilepsy: on levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD, seizure-free 6 months. Plan: continue, check serum sodium, creatinine.
Vitamin D deficiency: symptomatic fatigue. Plan: cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD; check serum 25-OH vit D, calcium, phosphate.
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
pregabalin 75 mg BD after food

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D: 12 ng/mL (ref 20-50)
 Serum calcium: 8.9 mg/dL (ref 8.5-10.5)
 Serum phosphate: 2.4 mg/dL (ref 2.5-4.5)
 Serum sodium: 138 mmol/L (ref 135-145)
 Serum creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.2)
 HbA1c: 5.6% (ref 4-5.6)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: L5-S1 disc protrusion causing ventral thecal sac compression, no cord signal change. Correlates with sciatica.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: EEG: background activity normal, no epileptiform discharges. No seizure focus identified.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Sciatica pain down right leg improved after 5 days of meds, still occasional tingling. No new seizures. Feel less tired after starting vitamin D. No side effects noticed.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Allergy: penicillin - rash and pruritus within 30 min of oral dose in childhood. Avoid beta-lactams.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Sciatica: pain reduced to 2/10, straight leg raise 60°. Continue pregabalin, diclofenac as needed.
Epilepsy: seizure-free, labs normal. Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
Vitamin D deficiency: after 8 weeks loading, level 28 ng/mL. Switch to maintenance cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD.
Weight 62 kg, waist 78 cm (male cut-off 90 cm).
Due: HbA1c 2025-10-12, lipid profile 2025-10-12.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Physiotherapy Department, Sunrise Family Clinic for core strengthening and lumbar stabilization for persistent mild sciatica. Advise 6 sessions over 8 weeks.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Physiotherapy report: patient attended 5/6 sessions, reports pain 1/10, improved flexion, home exercise plan provided. No adverse events.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Sciatica: asymptomatic, straight leg raise 80°. Continue pregabalin as needed for breakthrough pain.
Epilepsy: seizure-free 8 months, medication tolerance good. Continue current regimen.
Vitamin D deficiency: maintained on 1000 IU OD, level 30 ng/mL.
Weight 63 kg, waist 80 cm (male cut-off 90).
Due: HbA1c 2026-05-05, repeat vitamin D 2026-05-05.

Epilepsy: seizure-free >1 year, meds well tolerated. Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
